dependent_matter: Decide how Stategraph may participate in the Azure IaC MSP Lab without bypassing the Lab v1 completion gate or displacing the existing Bicep authority.

also_merged.title: Define Lab v1 completion gate and freeze feature expansion

repository_observation.claim_boundary: Live GitHub establishes the observed repository head and merged pull requests. Exact source-head CI passed for PRs #95 and #96. No workflow result was observed directly on the final main merge composition through the available connector.

iac_observation.interpretation: Stategraph cannot become an execution dependency of the existing ServiceTracer Bicep path through this increment. Any future working pilot must begin in a separate Terraform root with a standard Terraform fallback.

lab_v1_gate.reason: The gate freezes parallel feature expansion until the ServiceTracer P0-P2 vertical slice is complete unless a new item directly closes a completion criterion, removes a material security or operational credibility defect, or produces required demonstration evidence.

azure_boundary.claim_boundary: This reconciliation promotes no new Azure, runtime, RBAC, cost, quota, or deployment claim. Existing promoted Azure evidence remains time-bounded.
